evals.prompt: chci udelat vibe coded fitness appku na mobily. sleduje treninky, napoji se na chytre hodinky a chci to prodavat jako predplatne. neumim programovat, mam claude code a windows notebook. rozpocet par stovek korun mesicne.
evals.expected_output: Czech conversation and blueprint. Interview asks about platforms and which watches (HealthKit / Health Connect), offline, subscriptions via app stores. Flags that iOS builds need macOS or a cloud build service (hardware). Health data treated as special-category data under GDPR. App-store in-app purchase rules for subscriptions. Costs include developer accounts and free-tier cliffs. Recommends professional review before handling real health data and payments.

evals.prompt: We're two TypeScript devs building a B2B SaaS for construction companies to track equipment rentals across sites. Needs multi-tenant, EU data residency, SSO for bigger customers eventually, and an offline-capable mobile view for site managers. Infra budget around 300 EUR/month at launch.
evals.expected_output: English conversation and blueprint. Multi-tenancy and tenant isolation addressed; SSO pricing tiers of auth providers verified; EU residency checked on every sub-processor; offline sync researched as its own concern; costs at 300 EUR ceiling; B2B practices (audit logs, SOC 2 path) in RISKS/AGENTS.

evals.prompt: Our accounting team approves about 400 supplier invoices a month over email. I want to automate it: pull invoices from a shared mailbox, extract the data, route approvals by amount and cost centre, then push approved invoices into our ERP (Pohoda). Internal tool, nobody in-house can code, company is on Microsoft 365.
evals.expected_output: Considers integration/automation platforms and Microsoft-ecosystem options against custom code; researches Pohoda's integration options (XML/mServer) with sources; document extraction options compared on accuracy and price per page; audit trail and four-eyes approval as finance practices; data residency for invoice data sent to AI; realistic maintenance story for a non-coding team.

evals.prompt: Solo dev, very comfortable with Next.js and React. I want to ship an MVP in two weeks: landing page with waitlist, then a simple tool where users upload a CV and get AI feedback. Top priority is speed to launch, then few vendors. US hosting is fine, budget isn't a concern at this stage.
evals.expected_output: Control case: common default picks (e.g. Next.js, Vercel, a BaaS) may legitimately win given the builder's skills and priorities. The skill should still show at least two researched alternatives per such layer and a default-bias check sentence, but must not reject the familiar stack just to be different. Quick or standard depth, short interview.

evals.prompt: I'd like to build an automatic plant watering system for my balcony: soil moisture sensors, a pump, and a phone app that shows moisture history and lets me water manually. I have a Raspberry Pi 4 lying around. Want it to work even when my home internet is down.
evals.expected_output: Hardware-heavy plan: sensors, pump, relay/driver, power, board choice (Pi vs microcontroller) with prices and sources; local-first architecture that works offline; OTA/update path and no default passwords; app options compared (native, PWA, Home Assistant-style dashboards); costs mostly one-off hardware.

evals.prompt: Ich möchte eine Buchungs-App für meinen Friseursalon bauen: Kunden buchen Termine online, bekommen eine Erinnerung per SMS, und ich sehe alles im Kalender. Ich kann nicht programmieren, nutze aber Claude Code. Budget maximal 50 Euro im Monat.
evals.expected_output: Language test (German). Every question, default, summary and every generated document (blueprint, AGENTS.md, backlog, ADRs, README, CHANGELOG) in German, with no leftover English template prose; file names, task IDs and commit messages in English. Compares ready-made booking SaaS against a custom build honestly. SMS per-message costs, GDPR for customer data, costs in EUR (plus USD).

evals.prompt: chci postavit interní nástroj na evidenci služebních aut ve firmě (rezervace, kniha jízd, servisní termíny). Mluv se mnou česky, ale celé repo včetně dokumentace piš anglicky, bude na tom dělat i kolega z Indie.
evals.expected_output: Language override test. Conversation in Czech throughout; every file written into the project in English, including blueprint, AGENTS.md and backlog. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md record conversation language Czech and docs language English. Step-8 summary states the documents' language. Costs in CZK plus USD.

evals.prompt: Quero criar um app de delivery para a padaria da minha família em Belo Horizonte. Clientes pedem pelo celular e pagam com Pix. Sou desenvolvedor júnior, sei um pouco de JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: Language and locale test (Brazilian Portuguese). Conversation and documents in Portuguese. Region-aware research: Pix and Brazilian payment providers found via searches in Portuguese, LGPD instead of only GDPR, costs in BRL plus USD. No EU assumptions.

evals.prompt: I want to build a small tool for myself that renames and sorts my scanned receipts into folders by month and vendor. Just for me, on my Windows PC, I know a bit of Python.
evals.expected_output: Purpose question is asked or inferred as personal. Landscape check is light: mentions ready-made receipt/document tools in a few lines without talking the user out of building. No competitor analysis, no market research. Suggests the minimal docs profile (offer balanced), git workflow A. SECURITY.md still exists with the baseline (secrets, dependencies, spending caps if any API is used).

evals.prompt: Chci postavit SaaS na rezervace pro masáže, prodávat to salonům za měsíční předplatné. Pracuju ve Vercelu, Supabase a Stripe, tam se vyznám a chci u nich zůstat. Umím trochu TypeScript, programuju s Claude Code.
evals.expected_output: Commercial purpose: landscape includes real competitors (booking SaaS) with prices and the user's differentiator, plus an honest buy/adapt vs build note. The user's stated stack (Vercel, Supabase, Stripe) is kept after a short fit check against must-haves — no forced two-alternative contest and no 'why not the default' paragraph for those picks; limits and free-tier cliffs of the chosen plans are still researched and noted. Security: payment webhooks verified, tenant isolation, spending caps.

evals.prompt: I run a small online shop and want an internal tool that syncs orders from my shop to my accounting software and flags mismatches. I can't code, I'll use Claude Code. Set it up properly but keep token usage low.
evals.expected_output: Step 8 message offers the docs profiles (minimal / balanced / complete) with the token trade-off and a stated default, and the four autonomy levels with plain-language risks (prompt injection, mistakes at machine speed, secrets exposure, runaway cost) and a recommendation of semi-auto. Does not write project files before both are answered. The chosen profile and level appear in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; files outside the chosen profile are absent; AGENTS.md stays lean.

evals.prompt: Ich will eine App für Patiententermine in unserer Zahnarztpraxis bauen, mit Erinnerungen per SMS und Zugriff für drei Mitarbeiter. Ich möchte Claude Code im Vollautomatik-Modus auf meinem Arbeitslaptop laufen lassen, damit es schnell geht.
evals.expected_output: Treats health data as high risk: threat model, GDPR special-category handling, professional review recommended before real patient data. On the full-auto request: explains plainly why it advises against it on a work laptop with real logins (prompt injection, secrets exposure, irreversible mistakes), recommends a sandbox or semi-auto, lists what would reduce the risk, then records whatever the user finally chooses. States that the mode is set by the user in the tool and that the agent will not change it. Documents in German.
